> Quiet-luxury dental clinic in Bahria Town Phase 4, Rawalpindi, Pakistan.

## About

ORA Dental Wellness is a dentist-led clinic in Rawalpindi focused on considered, precise care in a calm atelier-style environment. Primary service area: Rawalpindi and Bahria Town Phase 4, with patients also visiting from Islamabad.

## Doctors

- **Dr. Ahmed Sultan** — General Dentist · Aligners Specialist (clear aligners, oral surgery, restorative & comprehensive care)
- **Dr. Roha Ejaz** — General & Restorative Dentist (cosmetic focus, aesthetic composites, veneers, smile makeovers)
- **Dr. Usman Khattak** — Periodontist & Implantologist
- **Dr. Ozair Shirazi** — Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon
- **Dr. Zain Iftikhar** — Prosthodontist · ITI Member

## Location & hours

- Address: Ground Floor, Plot 35, Street 8, Bahria Paradise Commercial, Bahria Town Phase 4, Rawalpindi 46220, Pakistan
- Coordinates: 33.542181, 73.110376
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM
- Appointments preferred; walk-ins welcome subject to availability

## Services

- Preventive dentistry (check-ups, scaling & polishing, fluoride, sealants, digital X-rays)
- Restorative dentistry (fillings, crowns, bridges, denture repairs)
- Endodontics (root canal treatment)
- Tooth extractions (simple & surgical)
- Gum care / periodontal treatment
- Cosmetic dentistry and teeth whitening
- Clear aligners / invisible braces
- Pediatric dentistry
- Emergency dental care
- Dental implants support
